svg.title: Distance is not permission for anyone to spend your money quietly.
svg.desc: Being far away should never mean being uninformed. YaVaKa keeps the record visible from anywhere.
svg.text: You are allowed to ask for the invoice. You are allowed to ask what a
payment bought. A good build team expects the question.
You should never feel rude for asking where the money went.
Every receipt, invoice and document — at every
stage — in your YaVaKa portal. Private to your
“Being far away is not the same as being uninformed.”
